title: Accountant (m/f/d)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant (m/f/d) based in France. As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team. Accountabilities: Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records. Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis. Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness. Follow up with vendors regarding missing invoices, prepare cost accruals, and contribute to profit and loss (P&L) reviews. Process supplier payments and bank transfers, ensuring that the appropriate approvals and internal procedures are followed. Reconcile intercompany transactions and investigate discrepancies to maintain consistent financial records across entities. Prepare German VAT filings, including Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung and Zusammenfassende Meldung, and support payroll tax declarations (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung) in collaboration with external payroll providers and tax advisors. Assist with the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with German Commercial Code (HGB) requirements, as well as statutory audits and tax filings. Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and compliance practices. Review and improve existing accounting processes, resolve outstanding items, clean up historical ledger discrepancies, and establish more efficient financial workflows. Prepare financial KPIs and management reports, validating data accuracy and consistency before submission. Support monthly variance analysis by comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts, investigating discrepancies, and providing relevant insights. Collaborate with the wider finance team on daily accounting operations, reporting activities, process improvements, and special projects. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for German accounting practices under HGB and German tax requirements. Experience in the software, technology, or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) industry. Solid understanding of accrual accounting, financial reconciliations, journal entries, closing procedures, and financial reporting. Practical knowledge of German VAT requirements and familiarity with payroll tax declarations and statutory reporting obligations. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and accounting reports. Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting and enterprise resource planning systems is an advantage. Experience managing multiple legal entities or multi-currency accounting is a plus. A professional qualification in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related discipline is desirable. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and reliability, with a commitment to maintaining high standards in financial documentation and reporting. A proactive, problem-solving mindset and willingness to resolve historical accounting issues, organize incomplete records, and improve existing processes. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and take ownership of responsibilities in a fully remote environment. Strong teamwork and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate proactively with colleagues, external advisors, and service providers across remote teams. Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new systems, expand responsibilities, and develop professionally over time. Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken. Residence in Europe and legal authorization to work in the country of residence. Being based in or near Berlin is an advantage. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement: Work remotely from an eligible location within Europe. International working environment: Collaborate with finance professionals and stakeholders across an international software group. Entrepreneurial team culture: Benefit from a hands-on environment that encourages ownership, initiative, and practical problem-solving. Professional development: Expand your accounting expertise and gain exposure to international financial operations, reporting, and process improvement. Meaningful responsibilities: Take ownership of day-to-day accounting activities and contribute directly to the accuracy and efficiency of financial operations. Career growth opportunities: Develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities as you gain experience. Collaborative finance team: Work closely with finance colleagues, external tax advisors, and payroll providers. Organizational stability: Enjoy the opportunity to work within an established international group while retaining the benefits of an agile, entrepreneurial team. Competitive compensation: Salary and any additional financial benefits to be confirmed during the recruitment process. Additional benefits: Healthcare coverage, paid leave, pension contributions, equipment allowances, and other employment benefits are subject to the applicable employment terms and should be confirmed with the hiring company. Help ambitious Swiss businesses expand internationally by removing the complexities of cross-border hiring and workforce management. As an Account Executive, you will own the full B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding. You will advise founders, HR leaders, and other decision-makers on workforce solutions that enable them to hire talent across borders compliantly. Working in a remote-first, international sales team, you will build a strong pipeline, develop strategic relationships, and turn complex business challenges into commercial opportunities. This role is designed for a results-driven sales professional who combines consultative selling with proactive outbound prospecting and confident deal management. You will have the autonomy to manage your territory, exceed ambitious sales targets, and contribute to the growth of a globally connected business. Accountabilities: Take ownership of the complete sales process across assigned Swiss accounts, building a strong pipeline and helping companies understand the value of international workforce solutions. Work closely with prospects and internal sales colleagues to identify business needs, navigate complex buying processes, and consistently achieve commercial objectives. Develop and manage relationships with Swiss companies seeking to expand internationally and hire talent across borders. Engage founders, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders, building internal champions and demonstrating the business value of proposed solutions to Finance, Legal, and executive decision-makers. Apply structured qualification methodologies, such as MEDDICC, to assess opportunities, prioritize qualified prospects, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline. Ability to substantiate sales performance with clear metrics, including quota attainment and closed-won results. Native-level Swiss German proficiency and business-fluent English for the Swiss German-speaking profile; alternatively, fluency in both German and French for the German- and French-speaking profile. Strong discovery, qualification, and consultative selling skills, with experience using methodologies such as MEDDICC. Confidence and persistence in outbound sales, including cold calling, personalized prospecting, and engaging busy founders and senior stakeholders. Ability to uncover customer needs, communicate business value, address objections, and navigate complex decision-making processes. Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a proactive approach to maintaining deal momentum and achieving sales targets. Familiarity with AI-powered tools and the ability to integrate them into daily sales workflows. Experience using HubSpot or a comparable CRM, with strong organizational skills and consistent data hygiene. Coachability, adaptability, and a willingness to seek feedback and implement improvements quickly. Excellent communication, relationship-building, and time-management skills in a distributed working environment. An existing professional network among Swiss founders or HR leaders is an advantage. Previous experience in HR technology, payroll, Employer of Record (EOR), or other compliance-intensive solutions is a plus. Additional French language skills are beneficial for engaging customers in French-speaking Switzerland. Creativity and resourcefulness in identifying new ways to reach decision-makers and generate qualified opportunities. Benefits: Competitive compensation starting from €50,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), comprising 60% base salary and 40% variable bonus, depending on location, skills, and experience. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.   Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.   With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.   At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. The Data & Automations Team The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability. The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions. Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver. The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought. Role As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams. You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written. Tech environment Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency. Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python
  • Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets
  • Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup
  • Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations:

  • Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch
  • Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success
  • Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects:

  • Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)
  • Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data
  • Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support:

  • Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes
  • Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

Collaboration & Learning:

  • Work with stakeholders - as diverse as Finance, People, Sales, and Product - to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices

What you'll do
  • Under the supervision of the Business Automation team’s more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.
    •  
    Automation Development:
  • Develop and maintain Python-based automations and solutions to streamline enterprise processes
  • Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods
  • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects
    •  
    Data Integration & Transformation:
  • Support the implementation of data pipelines that integrate data from various sources, including APIs, external databases, and third-party services
  • Assist in transforming raw data into clean and ready-to-use models using SQL and dbt
  • Collaborate on data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives
    •  
    Monitoring and Support:
  • Help implement monitoring for automation workflows and data pipelines
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing automation solutions
  • Assist in documentation of systems, processes, and workflows
    •  
    Collaboration & Learning:
  • Work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders - as diverse as HR, Sales and Product Engineering - to understand requirements and implement effective solutions
  • Continuously expand knowledge of data engineering and automation best practices
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions

    • Who you are

  • Technical skills

    The ideal candidate will possess most or all of the following qualifications. Hands-on experience through personal projects (share your GitHub account!), particularly contributions to open source initiatives, will be valued equally to professional and academic experience for this role.

  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g. layered or dimensional models)
  • Solid coding skills in Python
  • Understanding of ELT/ETL patterns, pipeline design, and data quality testing
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and CI/CD concepts
  • Practical experience with a public cloud provider and a cloud data warehouse
  • Attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify edge cases
  • Good understanding of AI and LLM principles, along with practical use of AI tools in your work
  • Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and verbal

    • Soft skills

  • Problem-solving mindset with critical thinking about business processes
  • Strong communication abilities - translating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and active listening skills for accurately capturing business requirements
  • A natural curiosity, eagerness to learn, and comfort asking questions early rather than staying blocked are an absolute must
  • Bonus points: Basic project management capabilities - tracking tasks, managing timelines, and reporting progress

    • Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with dbt, Airflow, or Terraform
  • Exposure to ingestion and reverse ETL tools
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered pipelines or applications

    • What we offer
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Remote-friendly environment

Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.

title: Senior Product Manager - Public APIs
description: Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot ,   based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture   puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75  (more about our culture here ). Our journey:  Founded in 2017 by   Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here )  - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ⭐ Mission Shape how Qonto connects to the rest of its customers' world by building the Public API strategy: a reliable, consistent API that powers integrations, partners, MCP and Qonto Embed, and turns connectivity into a growth engine for our all-in-one and upmarket ambitions. You will report to Fanny , who leads Qonto Connect, and you will own the product and governance framework that every Qonto team builds on. 👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As Product Manager, Public API, you will: Strategic ownership: Define the Public API strategy and roadmap for a product that already powers our integrations, MCP and Qonto Embed, and decide where to take it next. Meaningful, high-stakes impact: Make the API a reliable foundation for connectivity, helping Connect grow for our active customers. Platform thinking: Define a shared framework so that every Qonto team can build and expose its endpoints consistently, and partners can self-serve. Cross-functional leadership: Partner with PMs and engineering managers across Qonto to align on priorities and get API needs onto their roadmaps. 🤔 What you can expect Market context: The Public API is no longer just integrations. It now also powers MCP and Qonto Embed, so complexity grows fast and we need one person fully focused on its strategy. Team: You join the Connect team of 3 PMs (marketplace and bank aggregation, integrations, Public API), working with an engineering team that mixes backend and low-code engineers. The first question on your desk : what works well and what needs improvement in the Public API, how does each consumer of the API fit in, and what is our next bet in terms of use case tu enable and push via API. Tools: You work with the public API documentation (open to partners without a Qonto account), the developer portal, and AI tools. Being comfortable opening the docs or the code is part of the job. Rituals: a daily product and tech sync by scope, a Monday product weekly with peers, a Friday debrief to share wins and struggles, and a Monthly Connect showcase of results and new features. 🏅 About you Experience: You have solid product management experience and are comfortable owning a product that every other team contributes to, with a roadmap you have to build and defend yourself. API and technical sensitivity (a plus): You have worked on an API, integration, platform or developer-facing product, or you learn technical topics fast. You’re comfortable getting hands-on with API documentation and working closely with engineers. Stakeholder management and influence: You have aligned several teams around a shared product without hierarchical authority. You communicate clearly with PMs, engineers and senior stakeholders, and you consider the impact of your plan on every team before pushing it. Nice to have: Fintech, payments or partner-integration background, and curiosity for AI tools and vibe coding (we learn it together at Qonto). At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.   By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. More  information on our candidate journey here   ---------------------------------- ---------------------------------- ---------------------------------- 🔒 Your security matters to us Recruitment scams are on the rise. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare&nbsp;disease, and&nbsp;develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll&nbsp;ask&nbsp;"why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical &amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You'll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>You are a strategic IT partner with deep technical experience supporting BridgeBio's International organization across Commercial and Medical Affairs, G&amp;A, and Supply Chain functions. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports: BridgeBio's operating model delivers International IT work through external vendors and consultants, and this role provides both the strategic direction and the hands-on technical expertise needed to design, direct, and validate that work. You report to the Executive Director, IT Enterprise Applications in the US, and partner closely with International business leaders and US-based IT counterparts.</p> <p>You will own the International application and technology roadmap and business relationship, for Commercial and Medical Affairs systems including Veeva CRM, Databricks, and Analytics, while ensuring alignment with enterprise owned platforms managed by US teams. For core enterprise systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Malbek CLM, and Workday HRIS, you will act as the International liaison, ensuring local business needs, regulatory requirements, and market nuances are represented in both strategy and system design. You will direct and technically oversee the consultants and partners who execute this work.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to International business leadership, aligning technology strategy with business priorities, operational objectives, and long-term growth plans</li> <li>Shape and execute a multi-year technology roadmap for BridgeBio International, applying hands-on familiarity with Veeva CRM and data/analytics platforms (Databricks) to evaluate technical design decisions and identify digital transformation opportunities through data, automation, AI, and enterprise technologies</li> <li>Own end-to-end demand management, prioritization, and delivery of International IT initiatives, including business case development and investment prioritization, ensuring alignment with business strategy and cross-platform standards, and monitoring performance through KPIs and value realization metrics</li> <li>Own the technical design for International's Commercial and Medical Affairs applications, translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs that external partners and consultants can execute against</li> <li>Act as the International technical liaison for globally owned core systems (SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Malbek CLM, Workday HRIS), partnering with US-based application owners on integration points, data flows, and localization requirements</li> <li>Partner closely with US-based Enterprise Applications, Data &amp; Analytics, Infrastructure, Security, and End User Services teams, aligning on platform governance, technical standards, and roadmap decisions for shared systems like Veeva CRM and Databricks</li> <li>Direct and technically oversee external partners and consultants delivering International IT initiatives, since delivery capacity comes entirely through partners rather than an internal team: reviewing solution design, validating data integration approach and platform configuration, and holding vendors accountable to technical standards, timelines, and quality</li> <li>Build trusted relationships across International business leadership and key stakeholders, acting as the primary advisor on technology strategy and digital innovation</li> <li>Support platform expansion initiatives and pre- and post-product launch activities in key International markets, ensuring technology readiness, successful IT integration, and business continuity throughout the launch lifecycle</li> <li>Identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement across International applications, and propose pragmatic, business-aligned solutions</li> <li>Ensure compliance with IT governance, cybersecurity, SOX, GxP, regulatory, and data integrity requirements while supporting audits and platform governance activities</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You'll Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. In this role, you will lead the physical product design of hardware assemblies, mechanical housings, custom structures, and precision mechanisms, guiding products through CAD design, drafting, prototype verification, and industrialisation.

From day one, you will own the transition of concepts into production-ready physical hardware. You will maintain strict product data management standards, apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, run thermal and stress analyses, work with suppliers across various manufacturing processes, and perform hands-on prototype assembly and testing.

What You Will Do

  • CAD Design & Drafting: Create clean, fully constrained CAD models, multi-part assembly layouts, and detailed engineering drawings following formal geometric dimensioning and tolerancing standards.

  • Product Data & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change requests, update bill of materials data, maintain material libraries, and enforce configuration controls in digital product data systems.

  • Prototype Assembly & Verification: Build physical prototypes, test assembly sequences, verify fit and tolerance stack-ups, and establish unit build procedures.

  • Environmental & Stress Analysis: Perform structural, thermal, vibration, and mechanical shock simulations to ensure hardware survives harsh operational environments.

  • Manufacturing & Supplier Integration: Work closely with suppliers to optimize designs for production methods such as CNC machining, stamping, pressing, forging, casting, and injection molding.

  • Cross-Functional Interface Management: Collaborate with electronics, simulation, testing, and systems engineering teams to define physical interface control documents, packaging requirements, and technical datasheets.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • CAD & Drafting Experience: Strong proficiency in production CAD environments with experience applying formal drafting standards such as ASME or ISO GD&T.

  • Product Data Management: Practical experience with configuration management practices, engineering change notices, and product data systems such as Siemens Teamcenter or similar PDM/PLM tools.

  • Manufacturing Tooling & Processes: Design experience across multiple manufacturing methods including machining, stamping, casting, forging, and molding.

  • Analysis & Verification: Ability to perform basic environmental, thermal, shock, and stress evaluations to qualify hardware designs against operational requirements.

  • Proactive Execution: Practical mindset with strong hands-on skills for prototype assembly, vendor management, and technical troubleshooting.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to establish core mechanical design capability and elevate drafting standards within a growing engineering team.

  • Direct hands-on work spanning initial CAD concepts through to manufacturing and field testing.

  • Broad exposure to complex electromechanical hardware, structural housings, and safety-critical mechanisms.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management (UK/EU)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland</span></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview of Role:</strong></p> <p>The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role and Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supports the Senior Director in developing functional strategy, operating plans, budgets, governance and performance objectives across global clinical supply chain activities</li> <li>Leads day-to-day execution for new and ongoing studies and products, ensuring robust forecasting, supply planning, schedule adherence, inventory optimization, global logistics and sustained GxP compliance</li> <li>Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.</li> <li>Manages and develops direct reports, translating functional priorities into individual objectives, balancing workloads, coaching performance, supporting career development and ensuring appropriate succession and capability plans.</li> <li>Creates an effective management layer by coordinating team activities, reinforcing accountability, removing operational barriers and escalating material risks or decisions to the Senior Director.</li> <li>Overseeing the Clinical Supply Management (CSM) team, the Associate Director interprets complex clinical protocols, development plans and commercial demand forecasts, working with CMC and internal and external partners to develop packaging, labelling, supply and resupply strategies, timelines and plans.</li> <li>Supports the accountability of CSM team to oversee packaging, labelling, release, distribution, resupply, returns, reconciliation and destruction activities across global locations</li> <li>Develops and maintains supply project budgets, resource plans and integrated schedules, monitors performance and proactively resolves variances</li> <li>Manages CDMO and service-provider activities from RFP and contracting support through routine operations, troubleshooting, invoicing and performance management using defined KPIs and service expectations</li> <li>Supports IXRS selection, design, set-up, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), implementation and ongoing operational performance as required by IRT Management Team.</li> <li>Drives operational excellence by defining standard work, governance routines, KPIs and dashboards; uses trend and root-cause analysis to improve service, quality, cost, compliance and team productivity</li> <li>Leads continuous-improvement initiatives that streamline and harmonize processes, strengthen inspection readiness and embed sustainable ways of working</li> <li>Supports regulatory submissions, audits and inspections and ensures timely management of SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs within the function</li> <li>Provides continuity of leadership and performs other responsibilities within the function as assigned</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BSc, MSc, engineering or pharmacy degree, or equivalent, with a minimum of 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) environment</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading complex international clinical studies and product supply chains, with broad knowledge of regulatory and GMP requirements for IMP and commercial product packaging and supply</li> <li>Prior people-management experience, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing talent, delegating effectively and managing through others</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable priorities, operating rhythms, metrics and measurable team outcomes</li> <li>Strong operational-excellence and continuous-improvement capability, including process standardization, KPI management, root-cause analysis and sustainable implementation of improvements</li> <li>Solid understanding of IXRS design specifications, set-up and UAT, together with proficiency in clinical supply planning and forecasting tools</li> <li>Strong project, budget, risk and resource-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality results</li> <li>Expertise in outsourcing, supplier governance, negotiation and performance management</li> <li>Experience building, scaling or improving end-to-end product supply chains and associated business processes</li> <li>Ability to operate as a trusted deputy to the Director, exercise sound judgement within delegated authority and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations</li> <li>Confident communicator able to influence all levels of the organization and build effective relationships with global colleagues, customers and suppliers</li> <li>Able to work independently with complex global problems while fostering inclusion, collaboration, accountability and effective team leadership</li> <li>Agile and resilient in a dynamic organization where priorities may change rapidly</li> <li>Knowledge of the drug development process and applicable FDA, EMA and PMDA expectations, including GMP, GCP, Annex 13 and relevant clinical trial requirements</li> <li>Technically proficient with industry-standard systems and tools and able to use technology, data and industry trends to improve efficiency and decision-making</li> <li>Knowledgeable of and compliant with SOPs, title: Business Analytics & Insights Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>ABOUT SOTHEBY'S</strong></p> <p>Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.</p></div><p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>Working closely with the Head of Luxury Division and the Managing Director Switzerland, the role provides meaningful business insights, performance visibility and strategic reporting to support decision-making across the business. The position acts as an enabler to specialists and leadership teams by translating commercial and client data into actionable intelligence, helping identify trends, opportunities and areas of focus.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Client Analytics &amp; Growth Insights</p> <ul> <li>Leverage internal client data and CRM tools to provide visibility on client activity, engagement patterns and growth opportunities across categories.</li> <li>Support specialists and leadership teams by identifying client trends, areas of opportunity and potential cross-category connections.</li> <li>Contribute to client acquisition and development initiatives through data-driven analysis and actionable insights.</li> <li>Analyse client acquisition, retention and reactivation trends to support business planning and prioritization.</li> <li>Develop reporting and insights on key client-related KPIs.</li> <li>Collaborate with global client strategy teams to share best practices and ensure alignment of methodologies and reporting.</li> </ul> <p>Business Performance Analytics &amp; Reporting</p> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain reporting frameworks, dashboards and KPI tracking tools for the Luxury business.</li> <li>Provide visibility on performance across auctions, private sales and client development activities.</li> <li>Produce regular business reviews and performance reporting for the Luxury and Swiss leadership team.</li> <li>Monitor key performance indicators and highlight trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.</li> <li>Conduct pre-sale, during-sale and post-sale analyses to support business discussions and future planning.</li> <li>Develop auction intelligence reporting and market insights to support decision-making.</li> <li>Analyse bidding activity, buyer participation, conversion metrics and international selling patterns.</li> <li>Develop auction and sales performance reporting on the Luxury and Switzerland's contribution to the wider Sotheby's business.</li> <li>Translate complex business data into actionable insights and recommendations.</li> </ul> <p>Process Improvement, Automation &amp; Data Enablement</p> <ul> <li>Support strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing business visibility, reporting capabilities and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes through automation and AI-enabled solutions.</li> <li>Partner with P&amp;T teams to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities.</li> <li>Support the implementation and adoption of new tools, processes and reporting frameworks.</li> <li>Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring coordination, analysis and stakeholder engagement.</li> <li>Help reduce manual reporting activities and improve scalability through process optimisation.</li> </ul> <p>Leadership Reporting &amp; Communications</p> <ul> <li>Prepare executive-level presentations, business reviews and strategic updates for Luxury and Swiss leadership.</li> <li>Translate complex analyses into clear, concise and actionable business insights.</li> <li>Produce materials that support leadership discussions, planning and decision-making.</li> <li>Develop presentation materials for senior management meetings and business reviews.</li> <li>Facilitate communication across functions to ensure alignment on reporting, priorities and objectives.</li> <li>Ensure stakeholders have timely access to relevant performance, client and market insights.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>IDEAL EXPERIENCE &amp; raw.title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
raw.description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

 

EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

 

EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems. DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time. You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance. This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems. We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, solving technical problems, and working across disciplines. You don't need to be an expert in DNA synthesis, but you should have strong scientific fundamentals, an engineering mindset, and experience turning ideas into working prototypes. What You'll Do Design, build, and test prototypes for next-generation DNA synthesis technologies. Translate scientific and technical requirements into practical engineering designs and experimental setups. Scope and evaluate different technical approaches, components, materials, and equipment for prototype development. Develop and optimize the chemistry, materials, and processes underlying the synthesis platform. Design and execute experiments to characterize performance, identify limitations, and improve reliability. Work closely with mechanical, electronics, software, and automation engineers to develop integrated experimental systems. Troubleshoot complex technical problems across chemistry, hardware, and process engineering. Develop analytical methods and quality control strategies to measure performance and guide optimization. Help scale successful prototypes into robust, reproducible systems suitable for routine production. Work with external suppliers and engineering partners to source components, evaluate technologies, and accelerate development. What We're Looking For A strong background in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience designing, building, and testing experimental setups, prototypes, or laboratory equipment. Strong understanding of chemistry, materials, or process engineering, with the ability to apply these fundamentals to practical engineering challenges. Experience developing and optimizing experimental processes, including systematic troubleshooting and performance characterization. Comfortable working across hardware and experimental science, translating scientific requirements into practical engineering solutions. Experience selecting components, evaluating technical trade-offs, and iterating on prototype designs. Strong experimental skills, including designing experiments, analyzing data, and making decisions based on results. Independent, resourceful, and comfortable working on open-ended technical problems. A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a focus on building, testing, and improving systems rather than purely theoretical development. Experience with DNA or oligonucleotide synthesis, including chemical or enzymatic approaches, is a plus. Experience with solid-phase synthesis, surface chemistry, or chemical process development is a plus. Familiarity with microfluidics, high-throughput dispensing, or array-based technologies is a plus. Experience with laboratory automation, instrumentation, or custom hardware development is a plus. Experience with CAD, electronics, fluidics, or mechanical prototyping is a plus. raw.title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
raw.description:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus
