description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Consultant in Burson’s Corporate practice you will lead high-profile corporate communications and issues mandates for some of the most recognised organisations across the Netherlands. You will be the counsel clients turn to when reputation is on the line, leading integrated teams to deliver outstanding work that protects, builds and advances their standing with the audiences that matter most.</p> <p>We are looking for someone with deep corporate communications expertise and proven issues experience, who understands how reputation, policy and public sentiment intersect, and who can guide clients with confidence through a fast-moving and often complex landscape.</p> <p>You’ll be someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and is experienced in working with globally recognised organisations who lead their fields and expect their communications to as well.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Trusted client counsel</strong>: Serve as the trusted senior point of contact for clients, providing strategic corporate communications and issues counsel, and developing a comprehensive understanding of client objectives, stakeholders and sector dynamics across industries such as Energy, Healthcare or Technology.</li> <li><strong>Media &amp; Stakeholder knowledge</strong>: You’ll have a nose for news and a sharp understanding of the political, regulatory and media environment, and know how to develop insightful corporate and public affairs strategies.</li> <li><strong>Issues &amp; Crisis:</strong> Anticipate, prepare for and manage reputational issues and live crises – developing scenario planning, positioning and response strategies that protect and strengthen client reputation under pressure.</li> <li><strong>Corporate &amp; public affairs strategy</strong>: Shape and deliver integrated programmes that connect corporate narrative, stakeholder engagement and public affairs, ensuring clients’ voices land with policymakers, media, employees and the wider public.</li> <li><strong>Planning and creativity</strong>: Know what cuts through in the corporate, policy and issues space, and develop creative storytelling and content that builds reputation and earns meaningful engagement.</li> <li><strong>Day-to-day leader &amp; quality control</strong>: Direct overall account activity, ensuring seamless execution, brilliant delivery, and consistently high levels of client service.</li> <li><strong>Proactivity</strong>: Drive innovative execution across day-to-day corporate communications, campaigns and issues management.</li> <li><strong>Team player</strong>: Play an active and helpful part in client teams and broader Burson initiatives, demonstrating effective time management and acting as an agency ambassador.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Established corporate communications experience at Senior Manager or Account Director level, ideally within an agency, with demonstrable issues and/or crisis experience.</li> <li>Sector knowledge in one or more of Energy, Healthcare or Technology, with an understanding of the reputational, regulatory and stakeholder issues that shape these industries.</li> <li>Proven experience across Corporate and Issues &amp; Crisis, with a strong understanding of how to build and deliver effective reputation and stakeholder strategies for the modern media and policy era.</li> <li>A robust network of relevant media, policy, and stakeholder contacts.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage fast-paced, ambitious clients and dynamic portfolios, providing exceptional client counsel.</li> <li>Energetic and committed team leadership experience, capable of inspiring and motivating teams.</li> <li>High levels of intelligence, initiative, and integrity, with an ambition to create award-winning work.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills, coupled with a commitment to day-to-day excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-RE1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.</p> <p>Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a <strong>Senior Technical SEO Specialist</strong> to strengthen our technical capabilities.</p> <p>This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.</p> <p>You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.</li> <li>Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.</li> <li>Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.</li> <li>Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.</li> <li>Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.</li> <li>Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.</li> <li>Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.</li> <li>Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.</li> <li>Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.</li> <li>Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The technical expertise we are looking for</strong></h3> <p>For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.</p> <p><strong>You have a strong understanding of:</strong></p> <ul> <li>HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.</li> <li>HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.</li> <li>JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.</li> <li>Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.</li> <li>Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.</li> <li>txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.</li> <li>Structured data and Schema.org.</li> <li>Core Web Vitals and web title: Process Automation Engineer
description: Functieprofiel Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software). Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. Daarnaast: In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses Mogelijkheden voor remote support Geïnteresseerd!  Solliciteer dan snel via onze website.
